methods.label: General and special parallelogram properties
methods.explanation: A parallelogram has opposite sides parallel and equal, opposite angles equal, and diagonals that bisect each other. However, its diagonals are not necessarily equal (they are equal only for rectangles).
methods.levelReason: Uses Grade 8 parallelogram properties and the same-level equal-diagonal criterion for rectangles.
